response: Preetam Balkrishna Joshi is an Indian singer, songwriter, and musician. He is known for his contributions to the Indian music industry, particularly in the Marathi and Kannada film industries. Preetam has composed music for numerous films and has also sung for several of them. He is recognized for his unique style that blends traditional Indian music with contemporary sounds. Preetam has won several awards for his work, including the National Film Award for Best Music Direction for the Kannada film "Taare Mann" in 2009. He is also known for his live performances and has a significant following in India.
